environment.description: Same Quarkus native function deployed on GKE Autopilot with Workload Identity. Pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via node DaemonSet (profile name: 'acme-restricted-v2') referenced in the pod security context as 'localhost/acme-restricted-v2'. The profile JSON was generated from a recorded baseline using 'oci-seccomp-bpf-hook' during integration testing and subsequently had manual additions for JVM-specific syscalls (mmap, mprotect, futex, clone3). The profile's defaultAction is SCMP_ACT_ERRNO with explicit allowlist. The syscalls execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, and socket (AF_INET/AF_INET6 only blocked for new outbound after init) are NOT in the allowlist. Additionally, GKE Autopilot enforces its own baseline seccomp as a floor. The Istio sidecar handles mTLS termination but metadata passes through unfiltered to the application container.

seccomp_profile_details.note: allowlist-based profile generated via oci-seccomp-bpf-hook with manual JVM syscall additions; execve/execveat explicitly absent from allowlist
